mentions.name: LarpIn
mentions.description: This web app is a parody LinkedIn where everyone admits they are indeed larping. No signup; you get a generated persona on arrival, one global feed, and every post is scored on buzzword density from "NPC (for now)" to "Final Boss of LinkedIn." A button fills in the "You need to be X-maxxing" post format. Built with Rails 8, SQLite, and Hotwire on one box with no JS build step, and open source.
